### 🎨 Your look, your way
- New **look editor** in your Profile: headgear, face cover, hair, facial hair, face, plate carrier, backpack and colours for skin, uniform, gear, accent, eyes and hair — with a live 3D preview, a Random button and the old characters as starting points.
- Men and women each have their own hairstyles — crop, buzz cut, mohawk, shoulder-length and man bun; pixie, bob, long, ponytail, long + ponytail and bun.
- Your look is saved to your account and follows you everywhere. New players start with a random one.

### ⚖️ Fair hitboxes
- Every look is exactly the same target: helmets, hair, packs and vests are cosmetic, and shots pass through them.
- Outside "Classes" rooms everyone has the same body and the same stats.

### 🪖 Classes
- In rooms with **Classes** turned on, pick your class on the death screen — it takes effect when you respawn. The class sets your stats, ability and build; your look stays your own.
- Co-op (PvE) rooms have no classes.

### 🎖️ Operations — co-op missions
- A new PvE mode: **Operations**, scripted co-op missions for 1–5 players. Enemy numbers scale with the squad.
- The first operation, **Blackpine Station**: land in the woods, fight through a sawmill and a mountain village, hack the station gate, clear the compound and take down the boss in containment.
- Stages with objectives: reach a point, clear an area, hold a zone, hack a console, kill the boss. Your squad respawns at the last checkpoint.
- Armed soldiers: riflemen, armoured heavies with machine guns, and shotgunners that look for cover.
- **Downed, not dead**: at zero health you go down and bleed out over 30 seconds. A teammate can revive you in 4 seconds. If nobody gets to you, the squad spends a revive from its shared pool.
- The boss has phases. It calls in reinforcements and gets enraged near the end, with announcements on screen.
- Up to 3 stars per run, for completing it, beating the par time and not using a pool revive. Your best record per difficulty is saved.
- Join a running operation: drop-in players arrive at the current checkpoint.

### 🏁 Racing
- New Racing mode in the main menu, above PvP: rally cars on closed circuits for up to 10 drivers, no weapons
- Race (choose the laps; 30 s left for everyone once the winner crosses the line) and Time trial against a ghost of your own best lap
- Gran Turismo-style handling with assists on, or assists off for the purists; automatic gearbox with optional manual shifting
- Real damage: bumpers, bonnet and wing fly off, the engine smokes and catches fire, a wrecked car respawns after 5 s; the host can set damage to on, mild or off
- Chase, hood and cockpit cameras, look back with X, R puts you back on the road
- Global lap leaderboards per track, with the record and your best shown while you drive, and racing stats in your profile
- Garage: paint, accent colour, decals, racing number, rims, rear wing and extras, unlocked by finishing races, wins, podiums and kilometres driven
- Podium at the end of every race, plus a list of everything the race unlocked
- Recorded engine, tyre and crash sounds, skid marks, tyre smoke and dust, glowing lamps at night, a slippery road in rain and snow
- Race music with its own Music volume slider in Settings

### 🗺️ Map editor
- New Racing map type: draw a road by clicking points, with per-point width, banking, surface (asphalt or gravel), bridges and branches
- Checkpoints are generated from the road, or placed by hand; boost pads and a start grid
- Test drive a track straight from the editor
